summary: Comprehensive testing of Rhino Drishti new features (iteration 7): Advanced Relevance Filter, Pattern Detection Engine, Critical Alert Acknowledgement workflow, filter stats in scan/pipeline status. All backend tests passed (20/20). All frontend UI elements functional.

issues: Filter stats (filtered_out, translated) only appear after a scan is run - shows 'No scans yet' initially which is expected behavior

GET /api/alerts/unacknowledged - returns only critical/high severity alerts

POST /api/intelligence/{item_id}/acknowledge - successfully acknowledges alert
POST /api/intelligence/{item_id}/acknowledge - returns 404 for non-existent alert
GET /api/patterns - returns 200 with patterns array and count
GET /api/patterns - patterns have required fields (pattern_key, region, escalation_risk, etc.)
GET /api/patterns - escalation_risk values are valid (CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE, LOW)
POST /api/patterns/detect - triggers pattern detection successfully
GET /api/pipeline/status - returns 200 with filter_stats field
GET /api/pipeline/status - filter_stats includes last_filtered_out and last_translated
GET /api/scan-status - returns 200 with filtered_out and translated fields

Intelligence filter module (intelligence_filter.py) has well-structured hard filter with HARD_REJECT_KEYWORDS and HARD_ACCEPT_KEYWORDS
